OPENS Ch 20: ESCHATOLOGICAL-JUDGMENT CATALOG (vv. 1-12) — the chapter sets out the sequence of end-times-events. The catalog: (a) signs-in-the-heavens; (b) trumpet-blast; (c) general-resurrection; (d) gathering-to-judgment; (e) book-of-deeds-opened; (f) separation-of-righteous-from-wicked; (g) eternal-judgment-pronounced. Direct parallels: MATTHEW 24 par. Meqabyan's distinctive feature: the seven-fold-catalog compresses biblical-and-Second-Temple eschatological-traditions into a coherent EOTC eschatology-ordering.

JUDGMENT-THRONE FORMULA (vv. 13-18): direct paraphrase of REVELATION 20:11-15 ('I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them. And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before God; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works'). The verse-structure-and-vocabulary correspondence is one of the strongest STRUCTURAL-NT-PARALLEL passages in Meqabyan — paired with mq1 8:22 (seed-buried 1 Cor 15:36-38) + mq1 36:43 (Abraham-believed-God Rom 4 / Jas 2) + mq2 18:14 (1 Cor 15:22 Adamic-pairing) as the FIVE PRIMARY NT-STRUCTURAL-ANCHORS in the trilogy. Per CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX §57: the Meqabyan-Revelation parallel is ONE OF THE TRILOGY'S TWO STRONGEST APOCALYPTIC-NT echoes (the other being 3 Mq 1:1 messianic-figure + Isaiah 19:18-25 Egypt-rejoices typology). The Tewahedo apocalyptic-canon (Daniel + Revelation + Mäṣḥafä Hēnok + 4 Ezra + Meqabyan) integrates 2 Mq 20:13 into its eschatological-judgment-vision sequence.
